quests.name: Thirty Years of Nothing
quests.desc: She talks about one regret from thirty years on the road — not what the player expects. First glimpse of the person behind the veteran.

quests.name: The Professional Opinion
quests.pre: She has been watching the player handle contracts more carefully than evaluation requires.
quests.scene: She offers an unsolicited detailed assessment of the player's technique. When asked why she bothered: 'Professional habit.' Pause. 'You actually listen.'
quests.post: She picks up an additional contract the next day without being asked and frames it as shared efficiency.

quests.name: The Last Good Contract
quests.desc: One clean contract from her active years she still thinks about. The employer survived. She does not know why it still reaches her.

quests.name: Off the Record
quests.pre: She has been covering for the player at the Charter post in small, costly ways.
quests.scene: A senior examiner asks privately about the player. She gives a response so specific and positive it could not be purely professional. She knows this mid-sentence and does not stop.
quests.post: When asked: 'Thirty years of instinct.' No additions, no subtractions.

quests.name: What She Drinks About
quests.desc: The actual reason she has been drinking since retiring. She has never said it aloud. She says most of it now.

quests.name: Someone Chose to Stay
quests.pre: She has been waiting for the player to move on to a better contract. Three months have passed.
quests.scene: She says: 'You haven't left.' He says: 'No.' She sits with this for a long time. What she does next is the first non-professional thing she has done in six years.
quests.post: She does not drink that evening. She cleans the glass. The next morning she makes two cups.

quests.name: What Competence Earns
quests.pre: She knows exactly what this is and is furious about how much she does not mind.
quests.scene: First intimacy — brief, no framing. Afterward: 'Was that a decision or a reflex?' He answers. She considers it seriously.
quests.post: She makes the same choice the following night, this time having deliberately sat with it first.

quests.name: The Thing She Never Asked For
quests.pre: She has been chosen without asking three days running. She is aware and not stopping it.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy through SUBMISSIVE/SERVICE leans — she gives completely and finds that is not what this is. SURRENDER lean activates. She stops performing competence.
quests.post: 'I did not know that was what I was waiting for.' Said to the ceiling, not to him.

quests.name: Thirty More Years
quests.pre: She is still here. This is no longer unusual to her.
quests.scene: She tells him she is not taking independent contracts. Phrases it as logistical. It is not.
quests.post: 'Don't make me say it.' Pause. 'I already said it.'

quests.name: Four Hundred Years of Data
quests.desc: She describes the player's MP as the most anomalous phenomenon she has catalogued in forty years. She does not say this is why she keeps returning to the analysis.

quests.name: The Experiment That Asks Back
quests.pre: She has been treating the player as a fascinating research subject.
quests.scene: She asks a question that is not about his MP. She notices mid-sentence and finishes asking anyway. His answer deviates from predicted response. 'I usually do.' She closes her notebook without writing that down.
quests.post: She opens it again later and writes it down.

quests.name: The One She Could Not Predict
quests.desc: She talks about the one person across four centuries who genuinely surprised her. They are dead. She is not sad in the way she expected. She is describing a category she did not know she needed.

quests.name: Control Condition
quests.pre: She has constructed an experiment with the player as subject and herself as detached observer.
quests.scene: She runs the test. His response is wrong in the specific way that undermines the entire experimental frame. She runs it again. Same wrong response. She writes: 'Methodology compromised by variable I failed to account for.'
quests.post: She redesigns the experiment three times over the next week. Each design has the same flaw.

quests.name: What She Studies When Not Working
quests.desc: Four centuries of watching people — the specific pattern she notices about people who matter to her. She is describing the player's pattern without realising it.

quests.name: The Variable She Named
quests.pre: She has written the variable in her private notes.
quests.scene: He sees her notes. She does not take them back. VOYEUR inverted — she watches him read what she wrote about him. She does not look away.
quests.post: She says: 'The experiment is compromised.' He says: 'I know. Is that a problem?' She writes the answer down where he can see it.

quests.name: What Four Centuries Teaches About Wanting
quests.pre: She knows exactly what she wants with unusual precision. The precision is the problem — she can see the whole thing before it happens and it still has not helped.
quests.scene: DOMINANT/CONTROL leads — she runs the encounter precisely. VOYEUR lean during — she wants to see the exact moment he stops being studied and responds. When he does: 'There it is.'
quests.post: She puts her notebook away for two days. She finds this acceptable.

quests.name: Deviation From Expected Parameters
quests.pre: Her own responses have been deviating consistently. She has been tracking this.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SADIST/CONTROL leads but the player matches her precisely. This is the specific deviation. She escalates to find where he stops. He does not stop. DOMINANT lean met, matched, challenged. She finds out what she wants is not what she thought she wanted.
quests.post: 'I have been wrong about something for forty years.' She says this with professional neutrality. She is genuinely delighted.

quests.name: Confirmed Hypothesis
quests.pre: She has been carrying the hypothesis for four centuries: nothing can genuinely surprise me twice.
quests.scene: He surprises her again. Differently. She does not write anything down.
quests.post: 'I have to revise the hypothesis.' She smiles. 'This is my favourite kind of problem.'

quests.name: The Roads She Knows
quests.desc: She describes one border route and every checkpoint along it. The player pieces together it is the route she escaped on at nine years old. She does not say this.

quests.name: The Courier Who Stays
quests.pre: She has handed off every leg of travel before this one.
quests.scene: She does not hand it off. She rides ahead and points to the road fork. No explanation.
quests.post: When the player catches up and asks: 'The next leg is complicated.' It is not.

quests.name: Neither
quests.desc: The specific experience of being neither-thing: a border incident at seventeen, both peoples reacting to her simultaneously, what she decided that day about herself.

quests.name: What Competence Earns
quests.pre: She has been watching the player navigate border situations using knowledge she gave him weeks ago.
quests.scene: He uses it correctly with elven border wardens. She did not expect him to retain it. She watches this happen.
quests.post: She rides parallel to him for the next hour without pulling ahead. First time.

quests.name: The Belonging She Almost Had
quests.desc: One place, one year, she almost stayed. Why she did not. Why she has been moving since.

quests.name: The Checkpoint She Did Not Need
quests.pre: She knows every exit. She has been checking them less.
quests.scene: He notices she is not checking the exits. She checks them again — deliberately, one by one. 'Force of habit.' He says: 'You looked for a different reason.' She does not deny it. She puts her hand on the door frame and stays.
quests.post: She stops checking exits in rooms where he is. She checks them twice in rooms where he is not.

quests.name: Belonging Without Earning
quests.pre: She has been here four months. Nothing was specifically asked of her. She is still here.
quests.scene: He does not ask her to stay — he assumes she will. This is the specific thing she did not know she needed. VANILLA then SWITCH then SERVICE — she gives what she knows how to give.
quests.post: 'You assumed I'd be there.' He says yes. She is quiet. 'That's — yes. That.'

quests.name: The Exit She Stopped Counting
quests.pre: She has lost count of the exits in this building. This is unprecedented.
quests.scene: Extended scene — EXHIBITIONIST lean: she wants to be seen fully without being categorised. She is seen. He does not categorise. She cries briefly, unrelated to what they were doing.
quests.post: 'I did not plan that.' Pause. 'I have never not planned that.'

quests.name: The Road That Stays
quests.pre: She has been checking routes to elsewhere — not to leave, to confirm she is choosing to stay. She knows this about herself.
quests.scene: She gives him the one map she has kept to herself: the road back to where she is from. 'In case we go.'
quests.post: They go. She marks the gate post on the way out. He sees her do it. 'You are allowed to know what that means.'

quests.name: The Last Rite She Performed
quests.desc: The last time her Templar Path responded — eighteen months ago. What she was protecting. How she knew when it was gone.

quests.name: Gratitude Without Charity
quests.pre: The player helped her with something not required. She noticed it was not pity.
quests.scene: She thanks him with formal precision. Then, same voice: 'You did not have to.' He says: 'I know.' She is quiet. 'Most people explain themselves.'
quests.post: She does not explain herself the next time she does something for him.

quests.name: What the Path Felt Like
quests.desc: She describes having her Templar Path — the sensation of certainty and purpose — and why she has never told anyone it is gone, because then she would have to say what is left.

quests.name: Kneeling Without Varan
quests.pre: She has been kneeling in the empty prayer posture every morning since the Path went. Old habit.
quests.scene: The player finds her doing this. He waits. She finishes. He says nothing about it. Later: 'You did not ask.' He says: 'None of my business. Unless you want it to be.' She considers for a long time.
quests.post: She finds him that evening. 'Tell me about your calling.' Not his Path — his calling. She listens the way she used to listen to Varan.

quests.name: What She Would Have Died For
quests.desc: Specific — who, what year, and why. They are alive. She never told them.

quests.name: The Wanting She Allows
quests.pre: She has been examining what she wants — clinically, as a permitted investigation. It has been producing unexpected results.
quests.scene: She asks if wanting something for herself is wrong, and is asking about something specific. He says no, specifically. SUBMISSIVE then SERVICE then SURRENDER — the kneel she has been practising, redirected.
quests.post: She wakes up and her posture is different. 'I owe Varan a prayer of thanks for something she does not know she gave me.'

quests.name: Rebuilt From Oath
quests.pre: She has been rewriting her oath in her head for weeks. She has found the version that holds.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — DEVOTION fully active, SERVICE as structure, SURRENDER as core. She swears something. Not to Varan.
quests.post: She files the new oath where the old one was.

quests.name: The Path That Came Back
quests.pre: Something has returned to her. Not Varan's Path — something adjacent, something personal.
quests.scene: She draws on it during a fight. Afterward: 'I thought it was gone.' He says it is not. She looks at her hands. 'No. It is not.'
quests.post: She files the new oath where the old one was. The space is no longer empty.

quests.name: Twenty-Two Years of Listening
quests.desc: She describes what it was like to feel Varan's MP for twenty-two years — present, then absent, then the thin thread she has been following. What the thread sounds like.

quests.name: The Angel Who Stays Anyway
quests.pre: Her mission is the only reason she is here. She has been supplementing it.
quests.scene: He asks what she wants — not about Varan, about herself. She does not have an answer. She tries. The attempt is slow, genuine, and reaches something she does not have a word for.
quests.post: She watches him for the rest of the day in a way that is different from assessment.

quests.name: For Herself, Not the Mission
quests.pre: She has been testing the feeling — the something for herself. It keeps returning with his name in it.
quests.scene: SERVICE/DEVOTION fully active — she gives everything with an angel's precision. Midway through: 'This is — this is for me.' She sounds surprised. The surprise is genuine.
quests.post: 'That is what wanting something for myself feels like.' She examines this for a while. 'It is warmer than I expected.'

quests.name: What Angels Surrender To
quests.pre: She has been an instrument of a god for twenty-two years. She has never been an instrument of herself.
quests.scene: SURRENDER, then WORSHIP inverted — she is worshipped rather than worshipping. She does not know what to do with this at first. She learns.
quests.post: 'I understand now why humans build temples.' She looks at him. 'It is not about the god.'

quests.name: When Varan Is Free
quests.desc: When Varan is freed, Variel must choose what she is after twenty-two years of one purpose. She has been thinking about it. She knows the answer. Post-fall: she says it simply.

quests.name: Six Years of Terrified
quests.desc: The morning she found the first discrepancy — what she did that day. That she came back the next morning anyway.

quests.name: The Note That Stayed
quests.pre: She has been watching the player to see if he acts the same way when no one is evaluating him.
quests.scene: He acts the same. She passes a note at the end of a meeting — the smallest test: 'Are you actually safe?' He writes back one word. She folds it and keeps it.
quests.post: She asks him one question the next day that is not about work.

quests.name: The Colleague Who Guessed
quests.desc: There was one other clerk who might have noticed. What happened when they left. What she has been carrying since.

quests.name: Asking What She Already Knows
quests.pre: She has been working herself toward something using small questions as steps.
quests.scene: She asks a question that has been years in preparation. He answers. She was right. She asks if he would — and stops. He waits. She finishes.
quests.post: 'I have been rehearsing that for months.' Pause. 'It was easier than I thought.'

quests.name: The Document She Kept
quests.desc: The original discrepancy — what it cost her to keep it, what she was going to do with it before she found someone who would know what to do.

quests.name: Brave About One Thing
quests.pre: She has been circling this specific thing for weeks.
quests.scene: She does the specific thing she decided to be brave about. Not loudly — precisely. She focuses entirely on doing it correctly, which is how she does everything. He notices this is how she does it.
quests.post: 'I was scared.' Pause. 'Less than I expected.'

quests.name: Not Retreating From Herself
quests.pre: She has been staying. This is the bravery.
quests.scene: SERVICE and SURRENDER both active — she gives completely and finds that complete giving is exactly what she has been afraid to do for six years and is also exactly what she wanted.
quests.post: She stops asking if it was alright. She knows if it was alright.

quests.name: The Discrepancy She Is Solving Now
quests.pre: She has been cross-referencing herself the way she cross-references records.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — she applies her precision to something she has decided to become expert at. She has been studying. This is the test.
quests.post: 'I am going to get better at this.' She makes a note. It is the most competent sentence she has ever said about herself.

quests.name: The Next Morning's Record
quests.pre: She has been keeping notes on herself with the same rigour she applies to Varan's records.
quests.scene: She reads one entry aloud to him. It is specific, accurate, and she does not flinch.
quests.post: She files it. 'Evidence.' Pause. 'Of something I do not intend to apologise for.'

characters.name: Queen Maren II
characters.notes: Granite I — 14-18 quests spanning Acts 1-5. First-stage arc recorded here. Full arc continues in Acts 3-5.

quests.name: What a Queen Actually Does
quests.desc: She describes ruling from the inside — not the performance, the actual work. The specific loneliness of being the calibrated one in every room.

quests.name: The Foreigner Who Does Not Flinch
quests.pre: She has been testing every new person who gets close to her.
quests.scene: She applies conversational pressure designed to create deference or retreat. He does neither. She recalibrates and asks something harder. He does neither again.
quests.post: She asks Aldra about him privately, without framing it as anything.

quests.name: Thirty Years of the Calibrated Room
quests.desc: The cost of always being the one who reads the room accurately. One year when she let herself be wrong. The consequence was fine. She has never done it again.

quests.name: The Report She Does Not Write
quests.pre: She has been watching the player across multiple formal interactions. VOYEUR lean active.
quests.scene: She watches him handle a difficult Charter situation from across a receiving hall. She realises she stopped watching the room and watched only him for twelve minutes. She does not include this in her briefing notes.
quests.post: She sends him a task that requires proximity. She phrases the assignment as operational necessity.

quests.name: The Thing That Is Only Hers
quests.desc: She names one choice — one space, one decision — she has made purely for herself in twenty years of ruling. Just one.

quests.name: The Calibration Fails
quests.pre: She does not fail calibration.
quests.scene: She makes a calculation about the player that is wrong. He does something she did not predict. The specific wrong part: she predicted he would not notice her noticing him. He noticed. He said nothing.
quests.post: She adjusts. New prediction. He gets this one wrong in the same direction.

quests.name: What Voyeurs Lose
quests.pre: She has been watching safely. VOYEUR lens maintained.
quests.scene: He watches her back, specifically. She becomes aware mid-conversation that she is the subject rather than the observer. CONTROL lean in direct tension with this.
quests.post: She ends the conversation gracefully. She replays it three times on the way back to her ship.

quests.text: Granite arc continues Acts 3-5: 10+ additional quests covering marriage tension, political consequence, sexual humiliation escalation, first physical breach, mind break, and eventual fallen state. Design these when Act 3-5 content is in scope.

quests.name: The Correspondence That Was Not Official
quests.desc: The first letter she sent that was not state business. Who it was to, what she said, that she still has the reply.

quests.name: Treated Like the Equal She Is
quests.pre: She has been waited for, deferred to, and condescended to since birth.
quests.scene: He speaks to her as though she has specific knowledge worth hearing — because she does. She answers at full capacity with no performance. It takes her a moment to remember she can do this.
quests.post: She sends a follow-up letter within the hour. It is long.

quests.name: What She Prays For Privately
quests.desc: Not about Varan's return — something personal. She stopped confessing it three years ago because she could not explain it to the priest.

quests.name: Not Young
quests.pre: She has been braced for him to mention her age. He has not mentioned it.
quests.scene: He says something specific about a recent decision she made — respectful, accurate, treating her judgment as sound. She is briefly still. 'No one has said that.' He says: 'It is obvious.'
quests.post: She does not perform her age upward for the rest of the day.

quests.name: The Devotion She Redirected
quests.desc: She talks about Varan's church and what she believed growing up. The specific prayer she stopped saying after she understood what she actually wanted.

quests.name: The Event She Refuses
quests.pre: She has been keeping this separate from politics.
quests.scene: He visits without a political reason. First visit with no agenda. She knows this. VANILLA lean — she gives herself simply, without state architecture.
quests.post: 'I forgot it could be like that.' Pause. 'I have never had it be like that.'

quests.name: Without Politics
quests.pre: She has been testing what she is when she is not the princess.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SUBMISSIVE and SURRENDER leans, WORSHIP directed at her for once. She is fully present with no performance layer. She allows herself to be seen completely.
quests.post: She writes something in her private journal and marks it with a seal meaning personal — outside state archive.

quests.name: The Prayer That Worked
quests.pre: She stopped saying the private prayer three years ago. She says it again this morning.
quests.scene: She tells him what the prayer was. Then: 'I think it was answered.' The intimacy that follows is WORSHIP/DEVOTION — it is also entirely a religious experience for her.
quests.post: 'I am not confused about what I am anymore.'

quests.name: The Letter She Sends
quests.pre: She has been drafting this for a month.
quests.scene: She sends the letter to her confessor. She gives it to him to read first. It is the most honest document she has written since becoming princess.
quests.post: 'Varan would approve.' She thinks about this. 'I think she would.'
